scope: A2.7 and the vertex-form share of A2.10; later completing-square, formula, discriminant, regression, and full-application instruction remain out of scope unless separately approved.

families.higher_order_path: Analyze why algebra proves equivalence while sampled tables/graphs only corroborate it.
Compare methods and critique meaningful contextual domain.
Diagnose sign errors or construct a function from constraints.
Compare inverse operations, factoring, and graphing for efficiency and reliability.
Identify insufficient or inconsistent information and explain remaining degrees of freedom.
Select and defend the most informative form for a stated decision.
Create and evaluate a model by defending fit, domain, and limits of extrapolation.

expansion_recipes.evidence: Map corresponding features across two forms or a form and graph.
Locate the first invalid step, explain the misconception, and repair it.
Choose between valid methods using a stated mathematical criterion.
Prove, qualify, or refute a claim with a case, counterexample, or structural argument.
Construct a function satisfying several constraints and justify whether the result is unique.
Interpret domain and assumptions, then judge where the model is useful.

pilot_target.counting_rule: Count distinct reasoning families separately from numeric or surface-context instances.
pilot_target.proposed_new-family_mix: At least 40% of newly accepted families at Analyze/Evaluate/Create when lesson objectives support it; record exceptions instead of manufacturing quota fillers.
pilot_target.selection_rule: The lesson itself need not use every candidate or every Bloom level. The pool supports coherent selection.

rights_and_verification.recommended_student_use: Author original prompts and deterministic representations from approved mathematical families; retain source/page provenance internally.
rights_and_verification.answer_policy: Never fabricate an official publisher key. Independently derive a solution, label it authored, and require mathematical verification before approval.
